description: Two unrelated slow datapaths in one module: a 3-tap serial MAC (carry propagation) and a 40-way serial priority select (mux chain). Exists to test path selection — it is the only design here with two independent bottleneck cones.

known_bottlenecks: datapath A: serial accumulate chain t0->t1->t2 over three 16x16 products
datapath B: 40-way priority select written as a serial mux cascade
datapath B: req_q fans out to all 40 select stages at once
notes.invariants: rewrites must preserve 2-cycle latency and bit-exact outputs on BOTH datapaths; the two paths share no signal and may be rewritten independently
notes.purpose: path-selection testbed: a selector that reports one target here, or two that resemble each other, is broken
